nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256[] of staked token ids for each owner; mutated on stake/unstake.
Mapping tokenId => timestamp at which the token was staked; written in _stake, read by view functions.
Mapping owner => timestamp of the last unstake action.
Mapping tokenId => owner address of the staked token; set in _stake and deleted in _unstake.
Mapping address => bool used to track whether an address counts as a unique staker.
Public counter of unique staking owners; incremented/decremented in _updateUniqueOwnerCount.
IERC721Like reference to the staked NFT collection, used for ownerOf, isApprovedForAll and safeTransferFrom.
Oil (ERC20 reward) contract reference stored during initialization.
Address that holds the staked tokens; defaults to address(this) when the zero address is supplied.
External initializer of BibizStakeUpgradeable; resolves the staking contract address and calls the base initializer.
View function returning the staked token ids of an owner.
View function returning the owner recorded for a staked token id.
View function returning the staking timestamps for an array of token ids.
View function returning how long each token has been staked, computed with block.timestamp.
IERC721Receiver hook invoked on safe transfers to this contract; returns the receiver selector.
Internal base initializer granting DEFAULT_ADMIN, MANAGER and UPGRADER roles to msg.sender and storing the contract references.
External function unstaking an explicit list of token ids for msg.sender and rebuilding the owner token array.
External function unstaking every token of msg.sender and deleting the tracked array.
External function staking an array of token ids after checking operator approval and ownership.
Private helper performing the NFT safe transfer and recording staked token state.
Private helper performing the NFT safe transfer back to the user and clearing the recorded owner.
Private helper maintaining the stakers mapping and the uniqueOwnerCount counter.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted to UPGRADER_ROLE.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, role grants and token accounting.
Miner/validator influenced timestamp used for staking times and elapsed-time math.
Transaction origin; not referenced in this source but tracked as a potential authentication input.
External ERC721 safeTransferFrom(from=msg.sender, to=stakingContract, tokenId) executed at the start of _stake.
External ERC721 safeTransferFrom(from=stakingContract, to=msg.sender, tokenId) executed in _unstake.
Unchecked counter increment (uniqueOwnerCount++) executed when a new staker stakes.
Counter decrement (uniqueOwnerCount--) executed when a staker has no tokens left.
block.timestamp - tokenStakedTime subtraction used to derive seconds staked; timestamp dependent.
Parameter stakingContract_ of initialize.
Parameter tokenContract_ of initialize.
Parameter oilContract_ of initialize.
Local _stakingContract computed in initialize (defaults to address(this)).
Parameter tokenIds_ of stake.
Parameter tokenIds_ of unstake.
Parameter tokenId_ of the internal _stake helper.
Parameter tokenId_ of the internal _unstake helper.
Boolean parameter isStaking_ of _updateUniqueOwnerCount selecting the increment or decrement branch.
Parameter owner_ of tokensOf.
Parameter tokenId_ of ownerOf.
Parameter tokenIds_ of stakedTimeOf.
Parameter tokenIds_ of secondsStakedOf.
Parameter newImplementation of _authorizeUpgrade; unused beyond the role modifier.
Parameter operator of onERC721Received.
Parameter tokenId of onERC721Received.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the isApprovedForAll and ownerOf checks that gate staking.
tokenIds_ is iterated and each id is staked inside stake.
stake delegates each token id to the internal _stake helper.
stake updates the unique owner count after the loop.
_stake uses tokenContract to check and transfer the NFT.
_stake pushes the token id into tokensOfOwner[msg.sender].
_stake records tokenOwner[tokenId] = msg.sender.
_stake writes tokenStakedTime[tokenId].
tokenId_ parameter flows into the staking state updates.
Staking time is taken from block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value.
_stake performs the external safeTransferFrom operation.
unstake requires tokenOwner[tokenId] == msg.sender and mutates msg.sender's arrays.
tokenIds_ drives the unstake loop and array cleanup.
unstake delegates each verified token id to the internal _unstake helper.
unstake compacts and pops entries of tokensOfOwner[msg.sender].
unstake writes ownerLastUnstakedTime[msg.sender].
Unstake timestamp is set from block.timestamp.
unstake refreshes the unique owner count.
_unstake uses tokenContract to transfer the NFT back to the user.
_unstake deletes tokenOwner[tokenId].
_unstake performs the external safeTransferFrom from the staking contract.
tokenId_ parameter flows into the unstaking transfer and state deletion.
unstakeAll operates exclusively on msg.sender's recorded tokens and timestamp.
unstakeAll loops over the stored tokens and calls _unstake.
unstakeAll deletes tokensOfOwner[msg.sender].
unstakeAll writes ownerLastUnstakedTime[msg.sender].
unstakeAll records block.timestamp as the last unstake time.
unstakeAll updates the unique owner count.
_updateUniqueOwnerCount reads and writes stakers[msg.sender].
_updateUniqueOwnerCount mutates the uniqueOwnerCount counter.
isStaking_ selects the increment or decrement branch.
The increment branch unconditionally increases uniqueOwnerCount.
The decrement branch can reduce uniqueOwnerCount without a guard against underflow on repeated unstakes.
uniqueOwnerCount++ writes the counter state variable.
uniqueOwnerCount-- writes the counter state variable.
initialize forwards the resolved addresses to the base initializer.
stakingContract_ parameter is consumed by initialize.
tokenContract_ parameter is consumed by initialize.
oilContract_ parameter is consumed by initialize.
_stakingContract defaults to address(this) when stakingContract_ is the zero address.
The resolved staking contract address is passed to the base initializer.
tokenContract_ is passed to the base initializer.
oilContract_ is passed to the base initializer.
Base initializer stores stakingContract.
Base initializer stores oilContract.
Base initializer stores tokenContract.
Base initializer grants DEFAULT_ADMIN, MANAGER and UPGRADER roles to msg.sender.
owner_ parameter indexes the tokensOfOwner mapping.
tokensOf returns tokensOfOwner[owner_].
tokenId_ parameter indexes the tokenOwner mapping.
ownerOf returns tokenOwner[tokenId_].
tokenIds_ is iterated in stakedTimeOf.
stakedTimeOf reads tokenStakedTime for each id.
tokenIds_ is iterated in secondsStakedOf.
secondsStakedOf reads tokenStakedTime for each id.
Elapsed staking seconds depend on block.timestamp.
secondsStakedOf performs the timestamp subtraction block.timestamp - tokenStakedTime.
newImplementation parameter reaches _authorizeUpgrade but is not validated beyond the role check.
onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE) resolves authority from msg.sender.
safeTransferFrom in _stake triggers onERC721Received on a contract recipient, allowing a callback before state writes complete.
safeTransferFrom in _unstake triggers onERC721Received on a contract recipient during state cleanup.
operator parameter of onERC721Received is part of the callback payload.
tokenId parameter of onERC721Received is part of the callback payload.
